title: Names of Chinese Dishes
synopsis: There are many ways to name dishes in China. We present four of the most common methods.

fullText.simplified:
中国菜名

    很多人喜欢吃中国菜，中餐馆也开遍了世界各地。那你知道中国菜的菜名是怎么来的吗？ 中国菜多种多样，但菜名主要分为以下几种类型：
    第一种是“做菜的方法＋主要食材”。这种菜常常只有一种主要食材，比如烤鸭、清蒸鱼、红烧肉等。有时人们也会在最后加上菜的切法，比如炒土豆丝，红烧鸡块。最常见的切法有“片”“丁”“丝”和“块”。
    第二种是“一种主要食材＋做菜的方法＋另一种主要食材”。比如西红柿炒鸡蛋、土豆炖牛肉、青椒炒肉片等。因为这样的菜名通常都很长，而且大多数人都知道这些菜的做法是什么，所以人们有时候会不说做菜的方法，只把两种食材的名字连在一起。比如西红柿鸡蛋、土豆牛肉等。
    第三种是“风味＋食材”。中国很大，各地的菜都有不同风味，常见的有鱼香、麻辣、糖醋、酸辣、咖喱等。鱼香肉丝、糖醋排骨、咖喱鸡肉……这些都是中餐馆里的常见菜。有意思的是，鱼香味的菜里并没有鱼，而是厨师们将不同的调料混合做出了鱼的味道。
    第四种是“人名＋食材”。有这种菜名的常常是一些非常经典的菜式，比如宫保鸡丁、东坡肉、麻婆豆腐等。宫保鸡丁是一道非常有名的四川菜，也是很多外国人最喜欢的中国菜。
    除了这些种类的菜名以外，中国还有许多很有意思的特殊菜名。从菜名来看你看不出这道菜用了什么食材。比如“狮子头”里并没有狮子肉，而是一种大猪肉丸子；佛跳墙也跟佛没有关系，而是用二十多种不同食材做成。
    看完这篇文章，你知道在中餐馆怎么点菜了吗？
fullText.traditional:
中國菜名

    很多人喜歡吃中國菜，中餐館也開遍了世界各地。那你知道中國菜的菜名是怎麼來的嗎？ 中國菜多種多樣，但菜名主要分為以下幾種類型：
    第一種是“做菜的方法＋主要食材”。這種菜常常只有一種主要食材，比如烤鴨、清蒸魚、紅燒肉等。有時人們也會在最後加上菜的切法，比如炒土豆絲，紅燒雞塊。最常見的切法有“片”“丁”“絲”和“塊”。
    第二種是“一種主要食材＋做菜的方法＋另一種主要食材”。比如西紅柿炒雞蛋、土豆燉牛肉、青椒炒肉片等。因為這樣的菜名通常都很長，而且大多數人都知道這些菜的做法是什麼，所以人們有時候會不說做菜的方法，只把兩種食材的名字連在一起。比如西紅柿雞蛋、土豆牛肉等。
    第三種是“風味＋食材”。中國很大，各地的菜都有不同風味，常見的有魚香、麻辣、糖醋、酸辣、咖喱等。魚香肉絲、糖醋排骨、咖喱雞肉……這些都是中餐館裡的常見菜。有意思的是，魚香味的菜裡並沒有魚，而是廚師們將不同的調料混合做出了魚的味道。
    第四種是“人名＋食材”。有這種菜名的常常是一些非常經典的菜式，比如宮保雞丁、東坡肉、麻婆豆腐等。宮保雞丁是一道非常有名的四川菜，也是很多外國人最喜歡的中國菜。
    除了這些種類的菜名以外，中國還有許多很有意思的特殊菜名。從菜名來看你看不出這道菜用了什麼食材。比如“獅子頭”裡並沒有獅子肉，而是一種大豬肉丸子；佛跳牆也跟佛沒有關係，而是用二十多種不同食材做成。
    看完這篇文章，你知道在中餐館怎麼點菜了嗎？

sentences.simplified: 很多人喜欢吃中国菜，中餐馆也开遍了世界各地。
sentences.traditional: 很多人喜歡吃中國菜，中餐館也開遍了世界各地。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō rén xǐ huan chī zhōng guó cài zhōng cān guǎn yě kāi biàn le shì jiè gè dì

sentences.simplified: 那你知道中国菜的菜名是怎么来的吗？
sentences.traditional: 那你知道中國菜的菜名是怎麼來的嗎？
sentences.pinyin: nà nǐ zhī dào zhōng guó cài de cài míng shì zěn me lái de ma
sentences.english: Many people like eating Chinese dishes, and Chinese restaurants are everywhere in the world.
Do you know how Chinese people name their dishes?

sentences.simplified: 中国菜多种多样，但菜名主要分为以下几种类型：
sentences.traditional: 中國菜多種多樣，但菜名主要分為以下幾種類型：
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó cài duō zhǒng duō yàng dàn cài míng zhǔ yào fēn wéi yǐ xià jǐ zhǒng lèi xíng

sentences.english: There are a variety of Chinese dishes, but the names of Chinese dishes can be divided into these following types:

sentences.simplified: 第一种是“做菜的方法＋主要食材”。
sentences.traditional: 第一種是“做菜的方法＋主要食材”。
sentences.pinyin: dì yī zhǒng shì zuò cài de fāng fǎ jiā zhǔ yào shí cái

sentences.simplified: 这种菜常常只有一种主要食材，
sentences.traditional: 這種菜常常只有一種主要食材，
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng cài cháng cháng zhǐ yǒu yì zhǒng zhǔ yào shí cái
sentences.english: The first type is “cooking method + main ingredient”.

sentences.simplified: 比如烤鸭、清蒸鱼、红烧肉等。
sentences.traditional: 比如烤鴨、清蒸魚、紅燒肉等。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú kǎo yā qīng zhēng yú hóng shāo ròu děng
sentences.english: This kind of dish normally has one main ingredient per dish.

sentences.simplified: 有时人们也会在最后加上菜的切法，比如炒土豆丝，红烧鸡块。
sentences.traditional: 有時人們也會在最後加上菜的切法，比如炒土豆絲，紅燒雞塊。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí rén men yě huì zài zuì hòu jiā shàng cài de qiē fǎ bǐ rú chǎo tǔ dòu sī hóng shāo jī kuài
sentences.english: For example, roasted duck, steamed fish, pork braised in soy sauce and so on.

sentences.simplified: 最常见的切法有“片”“丁”“丝”和“块”。
sentences.traditional: 最常見的切法有“片”“丁”“絲”和“塊”。
sentences.pinyin: zuì cháng jiàn de qiē fǎ yǒu piàn dīng sī hé kuài
sentences.english: Sometimes people add the cutting method as well, such as fried shredded potato and braised chicken chunks.
The most common cutting methods are “sliced”, “diced”, “shredded” and “chunks”.

sentences.simplified: 第二种是“一种主要食材＋做菜的方法＋另一种主要食材”。
sentences.traditional: 第二種是“一種主要食材＋做菜的方法＋另一種主要食材”。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr zhǒng shì yì zhǒng zhǔ yào shí cái jiā zuò cài de fāng fǎ jiā lìng yì zhǒng zhǔ yào shí cái

sentences.simplified: 比如西红柿炒鸡蛋、土豆炖牛肉、青椒炒肉片等。
sentences.traditional: 比如西紅柿炒雞蛋、土豆燉牛肉、青椒炒肉片等。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú xī hóng shì chǎo jī dàn tǔ dòu dùn niú ròu qīng jiāo chǎo ròu piàn děng
sentences.english: The second type is “one main ingredient + cooking method + another main ingredient”.

sentences.simplified: 因为这样的菜名通常都很长，而且大多数人都知道这些菜的做法是什么，
sentences.traditional: 因為這樣的菜名通常都很長，而且大多數人都知道這些菜的做法是什麼，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zhè yàng de cài míng tōng cháng dōu hěn cháng ér qiě dà duō shù rén dōu zhī dào zhè xiē cài de zuò fǎ shì shén me
sentences.english: For example, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stewed beef with potato, fried pork with green pepper and so on.

sentences.simplified: 所以人们有时候会不说做菜的方法，只把两种食材的名字连在一起。
sentences.traditional: 所以人們有時候會不說做菜的方法，只把兩種食材的名字連在一起。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ rén men yǒu shí hou huì bù shuō zuò cài de fāng fǎ zhǐ bǎ liǎng zhǒng shí cái de míng zi lián zài yì qǐ
sentences.english: Because these names are often quite long, and most people already know the cooking method of these dishes, ..

sentences.simplified: 比如西红柿鸡蛋、土豆牛肉等。
sentences.traditional: 比如西紅柿雞蛋、土豆牛肉等。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú xī hóng shì jī dàn tǔ dòu niú ròu děng
sentences.english: .. people sometimes will skip the cooking method and only put two main ingredients together.
Such as scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and stewed beef with potato.

sentences.simplified: 第三种是“风味＋食材”。
sentences.traditional: 第三種是“風味＋食材”。
sentences.pinyin: dì sān zhǒng shì fēng wèi jiā shí cái

sentences.simplified: 中国很大，各地的菜都有不同风味，
sentences.traditional: 中國很大，各地的菜都有不同風味，
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó hěn dà gè dì de cài dōu yǒu bù tóng fēng wèi
sentences.english: The third type is “flavor + ingredient”.

sentences.simplified: 常见的有鱼香、麻辣、糖醋、酸辣、咖喱等。
sentences.traditional: 常見的有魚香、麻辣、糖醋、酸辣、咖喱等。
sentences.pinyin: cháng jiàn de yǒu yú xiāng má là táng cù suān là gā lí děng
sentences.english: China is a big country and dishes from different areas have different flavors.

sentences.simplified: 鱼香肉丝、糖醋排骨、咖喱鸡肉……
sentences.traditional: 魚香肉絲、糖醋排骨、咖喱雞肉……
sentences.pinyin: yú xiāng ròu sī táng cù pái gǔ gā lí jī ròu
sentences.english: Some common flavors are fish flavor, spicy and numb, sweet and sour, hot and sour, curry and so on.

sentences.simplified: 这些都是中餐馆里的常见菜。
sentences.traditional: 這些都是中餐館裡的常見菜。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē dōu shì zhōng cān guǎn lǐ de cháng jiàn cài
sentences.english: Shredded pork in fish flavor chili sauce, sweat and sour spareribs, curry chicken…

sentences.simplified: 有意思的是，鱼香味的菜里并没有鱼，
sentences.traditional: 有意思的是，魚香味的菜裡並沒有魚，
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yì si de shì yú xiāng wèi de cài lǐ bìng méi yǒu yú
sentences.english: All these are common dishes in Chinese restaurants.

sentences.simplified: 而是厨师们将不同的调料混合做出了鱼的味道。
sentences.traditional: 而是廚師們將不同的調料混合做出了魚的味道。
sentences.pinyin: ér shì chú shī men jiāng bù tóng de tiáo liào hùn hé zuò chū le yú de wèi dào
sentences.english: An interesting thing is that there is no fish in the fish flavored dishes.
Chefs mix different seasonings together to create fish flavor.

sentences.simplified: 第四种是“人名＋食材”。
sentences.traditional: 第四種是“人名＋食材”。
sentences.pinyin: dì sì zhǒng shì rén míng jiā shí cái

sentences.simplified: 有这种菜名的常常是一些非常经典的菜式，比如宫保鸡丁、东坡肉、麻婆豆腐等。
sentences.traditional: 有這種菜名的常常是一些非常經典的菜式，比如宮保雞丁、東坡肉、麻婆豆腐等。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu zhè zhǒng cài míng de cháng cháng shì yì xiē fēi cháng jīng diǎn de cài shì bǐ rú gōng bǎo jī dīng dōng pō ròu má pó dòu fu děng
sentences.english: The fourth type is “a person’s name + ingredient”.

sentences.simplified: 宫保鸡丁是一道非常有名的四川菜，也是很多外国人最喜欢的中国菜。
sentences.traditional: 宮保雞丁是一道非常有名的四川菜，也是很多外國人最喜歡的中國菜。
sentences.pinyin: gōng bǎo jī dīng shì yí dào fēi cháng yǒu míng de sì chuān cài yě shì hěn duō wài guó rén zuì xǐ huan de zhōng guó cài
sentences.english: Dishes with this kind of name are often very traditional, such as Kung Pao chicken, Dong Po pork and Ma Po tofu.
Kung Pao chicken is a very famous Sichuan dish, and is also considered to be many foreigners’ favorite dish.

sentences.simplified: 除了这些种类的菜名以外，中国还有许多很有意思的特殊菜名。
sentences.traditional: 除了這些種類的菜名以外，中國還有許多很有意思的特殊菜名。
sentences.pinyin: chú le zhè xiē zhǒng lèi de cài míng yǐ wài zhōng guó hái yǒu xǔ duō hěn yǒu yì si de tè shū cài míng

sentences.simplified: 从菜名来看你看不出这道菜用了什么食材。
sentences.traditional: 從菜名來看你看不出這道菜用了什麼食材。
sentences.pinyin: cóng cài míng lái kàn nǐ kàn bu chū zhè dào cài yòng le shén me shí cái
sentences.english: Beside these types, there are also many other interesting and specially named dishes in China.

sentences.simplified: 比如“狮子头”里并没有狮子肉，而是一种大猪肉丸子；
sentences.traditional: 比如“獅子頭”裡並沒有獅子肉，而是一種大豬肉丸子；
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú shī zi tóu lǐ bìng méi yǒu shī zi ròu ér shì yì zhǒng dà zhū ròu wán zi
sentences.english: You won’t be able to tell what ingredients they use in the dish from the name.

sentences.simplified: 佛跳墙也跟佛没有关系，
sentences.traditional: 佛跳牆也跟佛沒有關係，
sentences.pinyin: fó tiào qiáng yě gēn fó méi yǒu guān xi
sentences.english: For example, there is no lion in the dish “Lion's head”, instead it’s a kind of big meatballs.

sentences.simplified: 而是用二十多种不同食材做成。
sentences.traditional: 而是用二十多種不同食材做成。
sentences.pinyin: ér shì yòng èr shí duō zhǒng bù tóng shí cái zuò chéng
sentences.english: The dish “Buddha jumping over the wall” has nothing to do with Buddha, ..
.. it does however consist of over twenty different ingredients.

sentences.simplified: 看完这篇文章，你知道在中餐馆怎么点菜了吗？
sentences.traditional: 看完這篇文章，你知道在中餐館怎麼點菜了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: kàn wán zhè piān wén zhāng nǐ zhī dào zài zhōng cān guǎn zěn me diǎn cài le ma

sentences.english: After reading this article, do you know how to order food in a Chinese restaurant?

raw.synopsis: There are many ways to name dishes in China. We present four of the most common methods.
sentence_translations: Names of Chinese Dishes
Many people like eating Chinese dishes, and Chinese restaurants are everywhere in the world.
Do you know how Chinese people name their dishes?
There are a variety of Chinese dishes, but the names of Chinese dishes can be divided into these following types:
The first type is “cooking method + main ingredient”.
This kind of dish normally has one main ingredient per dish.
For example, roasted duck, steamed fish, pork braised in soy sauce and so on.
Sometimes people add the cutting method as well, such as fried shredded potato and braised chicken chunks.
The most common cutting methods are “sliced”, “diced”, “shredded” and “chunks”.
The second type is “one main ingredient + cooking method + another main ingredient”.
For example, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stewed beef with potato, fried pork with green pepper and so on.
Because these names are often quite long, and most people already know the cooking method of these dishes, ..
.. people sometimes will skip the cooking method and only put two main ingredients together.
Such as scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and stewed beef with potato.
The third type is “flavor + ingredient”.
China is a big country and dishes from different areas have different flavors.
Some common flavors are fish flavor, spicy and numb, sweet and sour, hot and sour, curry and so on.
Shredded pork in fish flavor chili sauce, sweat and sour spareribs, curry chicken…
All these are common dishes in Chinese restaurants.
An interesting thing is that there is no fish in the fish flavored dishes.
Chefs mix different seasonings together to create fish flavor.
The fourth type is “a person’s name + ingredient”.
Dishes with this kind of name are often very traditional, such as Kung Pao chicken, Dong Po pork and Ma Po tofu.
Kung Pao chicken is a very famous Sichuan dish, and is also considered to be many foreigners’ favorite dish.
Beside these types, there are also many other interesting and specially named dishes in China.
You won’t be able to tell what ingredients they use in the dish from the name.
For example, there is no lion in the dish “Lion's head”, instead it’s a kind of big meatballs.
The dish “Buddha jumping over the wall” has nothing to do with Buddha, ..
.. it does however consist of over twenty different ingredients.
After reading this article, do you know how to order food in a Chinese restaurant?
